title: 第十五章 凤鸾天女第十六章 离开慕容

read2（）;醒过来的仙儿看到坐在自己身旁静静修炼的林无缺，清澈的眸子里泛出一阵喜意，随即好像又想到了什么，细细的黛眉微微一蹙。
似乎感觉到阳光带来的温暖，林无缺浑身一震，修炼一夜的圣道战气缓缓归于平息，紧闭的眼睛随即睁开，恰巧对上了仙儿那清澈的眸子，后者露出了一个甜甜的笑容。
脸上露出喜意，林无缺赶忙站起身来关切的问道：“仙儿，你醒了，感觉如何……”
看着林无缺俊秀面孔上闪过的关切，仙儿心中温暖一片，目光扫过林无缺的右手，发觉涂着疗伤药，仙儿明白，昨晚，这个好似他亲哥哥的少年也许又救了她一命。
仙儿娇艳的脸蛋上划过一丝莫名的不舍，便从床榻之上坐了起来，望着林无缺露出明亮的笑容：“无缺哥哥，昨晚若不是你，想必仙儿早就化成了飞灰了，说来，这是无缺哥哥你第二次救了仙儿的性命了。”
仙儿的声音清脆动听，却蕴含着真挚的感激与浓浓的濡沫之情。
此话落在林无缺的耳中，他佯装一怒：“仙儿，你再和无缺哥哥这么见外，无缺哥哥就走了。”
“好啦，仙儿知道错了。”
这十年来，林无缺和仙儿之间，积累了极为深厚的兄妹之情，对于林无缺来说，在整个慕容家，对于他最放不下的唯有慕容长青和仙儿，前者是他尊敬的长辈，后者则是他爱护的妹妹。
“仙儿，既然你没事，我也就放心了，你好好休息，我先走了，回头我再来看你。”
守了一夜的少年摸了摸仙儿秀发，便准备转身离开，他知道，仙儿身上或许藏着秘密，毕竟昨晚的那一幕让他明白了许多，但这有如何？
对于林无缺来说，仙儿就是他的妹妹，妹妹不愿说，他也不会问，重要的是，只要仙儿平安就好。
仙儿原本挂着笑容的俏脸不知何时化作了深深的不舍，看着林无缺准备离开的身影，突然幽幽开口道：“无缺哥哥，仙儿…要离开了……”
少女满怀不舍的话语落在林无缺耳中，使得他脚步一顿，眼中同样闪过丝丝不舍，或许在林无缺的心中，早就明白仙儿迟早会离开慕容家，只是没有想到，来的这样的快。
“无缺哥哥，仙儿和你一样，是被寄养在慕容家，一晃，已经十年了。这十年来，仙儿过的很平静也很开心。慕容家虽小，却有着别处没有的宁静与祥和，在这里，我的日子不需要害怕，不需要悲伤。还有你，无缺哥哥，有你一直在仙儿的身边，让仙儿感觉到家人的温暖，让仙儿明白这世上还有仙儿珍视的东西，这一切，仙儿不会忘……”
似乎心中的那根弦被深深拨动，仙儿清澈的眸子悄悄眼泪婆娑，但却没有过多的难过，只是深深的不舍。
一双温暖白皙的手轻轻的将少女拥入了怀中，林无缺抚摸着仙儿的秀发，目光当中亦是不舍，但低沉的话语却在仙儿耳边响起：“傻仙儿，又不是生离死别，离开慕容家，不代表我们不能再见面，你看我也即将要离开慕容家去参加百城大战，还好是你先向我道的别，这要是换成我，是不是也要流几滴眼泪啊？”
“噗哧”
趴在林无缺肩膀上的仙儿忍不住笑出声来，小手轻轻拍了一下林无缺：“讨厌！无缺哥哥你又取笑人家……”

仙儿不舍的心在林无缺的这句调笑下似乎被冲淡了不少，她望着林无缺俊秀的脸庞，温柔的目光，轻轻的问道：“无缺哥哥，你以后一定要来找仙儿，好不好？”
感受到仙儿的期盼和忐忑，林无缺心中忍不住一酸，他自幼没有父母陪在身边，与福伯也是早早分开，慕容长青虽视他为己出，但带给林无缺最温柔犹如平辈家人感觉的却是仙儿。
如今或许分别在即，林无缺心中的不舍丝毫不亚于仙儿。
“当然，不管路途多么遥远，无缺哥哥以后一定会去看你的，这是无缺哥哥的承诺。”
林无缺重重的点了点头，目光坚定，语气坚定。
听到林无缺的肯定，仙儿再度破涕为笑，同样重重的点了点螓首，二者相视，露出温暖的笑容。
……
“由此一别，不知再相见又会是何种情形？空，人真的逃不开离别么？”
略带惆怅话轻轻在心中响起，离开仙儿小楼的林无缺漫步在石板小路上，微风带来一丝离别的不舍，轻轻拂过林无缺的脸颊。
“呵呵，天下无不散之宴席，纵然是血肉至亲，总有一天，也会有离别……你放心吧，这个小姑娘乃是凤鸾天女一脉，以她昨晚融真灵的状态，在凤鸾天女也必然拥有不低的地位，虽然不知道为何凤鸾天女会让这样的门人寄养在慕容家这样的小地方，但她以后的日子，只会越来越好。”
“凤鸾天女？好像很厉害的样子，到底是怎样的存在？”
对于空能知道凤鸾天女，林无缺倒是不奇怪，空只是失去了有关自己是谁这最段重要的记忆，但其他一些对于他来说不算多重要的记忆还是可以想起来，例如辨认丹药也是如此。
凤鸾天女，让林无缺心中产生了一丝好奇。
“在我残留的记忆中，倒是有着一些对此的描述，这也是我为何可以分辨那个小姑娘是在融真灵的原因。凤鸾天女，不是代表一个人，而是一个传承悠久势力的统称，她们一门上下皆是女子，却个个强大非凡，就算是在那众势力汇聚的地方，也是拥有着极为不弱的名声！”
“凤鸾天女一脉功法奇特，威力奇绝，皆是源自于她们体内与生俱来的伴生真灵。凤鸾天女每年都会派出无数的门人子弟探查天下，寻找身怀真灵尚在襁褓的女婴，将她们收入门下，这个小姑娘想来也是如此。不过凤鸾天女一脉虽然强大，但脾气也是古怪，不好相与。”
“哦？倒是个颇为奇特的势力。
空的解释让林无缺也是暗暗称奇，但他也明白仙儿回到凤鸾天女之后必然不会受苦，心中的担忧倒也暂时放下。
“总之，努力吧，以你的资质，若不是为了凝聚斗战圣法本源寂灭十年，如今的成就，必然不会在那君山烈之下。但凡事一饮一啄，你耗去十年凝聚圣法本源，以后，你会从中获得天大的造化。无缺，这个世界很大，只要你不断的变强，总有一天，会发现这个世界精彩无限。”
林无缺何尝不明白这是空在变相的开导他，微微一笑，收拾了心情，身形闪动，他向着慕容长青所住的地方急驰而去。
“长青叔叔，无缺求见。”

read2(); Xian'er woke up and saw Lin Wuque sitting beside him practicing quietly. There was a burst of joy in his clear eyes, and then he seemed to think of something again, and his thin eyebrows frowned slightly.
As if he felt the warmth brought by the sun, Lin Wuque was shocked all over. The fighting spirit of the holy way that he had cultivated all night slowly subsided. His closed eyes immediately opened, and he happened to meet Xian'er's clear eyes, who showed a sweet smile.
With joy on his face, Lin Wuque quickly stood up and asked with concern: "Xian'er, you're awake, how do you feel..."
Seeing the concern flashing across Lin Wuque's handsome face, Xian'er felt warm in her heart. She glanced at Lin Wuque's right hand and found that it was coated with healing medicine. Xian'er understood that last night, this young man who looked like his own brother might have saved her life again.
A trace of inexplicable reluctance flashed across Xian'er's pretty face, and she sat up from the bed, looking at Lin Wuque with a bright smile: "Brother Wuque, if it hadn't been for you last night, Xianer would have turned into ashes long ago. In other words, this is the second time that you saved Xianer's life, brother Wuque."
Xian'er's voice was clear and sweet, but it contained sincere gratitude and deep emotions.
These words fell on Lin Wuque's ears, and he pretended to be angry: "Xian'er, if you see brother Wuque like this again, brother Wuque will leave."
"Okay, Xian'er knows I was wrong."
In the past ten years, Lin Wuque and Xian'er have accumulated a very deep brother-sister relationship. For Lin Wuque, in the entire Murong family, the only people he can't let go of are Murong Changqing and Xian'er. The former is his respected elder, and the latter is his cherished sister.
"Xian'er, since you're fine, I'm relieved. You have a good rest. I'll leave first. I'll see you later."
The young man who had been watching all night touched Xian'er's hair and was about to turn around and leave. He knew that Xian'er might have a secret hidden in her body. After all, the scene last night made him understand a lot, but what did it matter?
For Lin Wuque, Xian'er was his sister. If his sister didn't want to tell him, he wouldn't ask. The important thing was, as long as Xian'er was safe.
Xianer's pretty face with a smile turned into deep reluctance at some point. Looking at Lin Wuque preparing to leave, she suddenly said quietly: "Brother Wuque, Xianer... is leaving..."
The girl's reluctant words fell on Lin Wuque's ears, causing him to pause in his steps, and a trace of reluctance flashed in his eyes. Perhaps in Lin Wuque's heart, he had already known that Xian'er would leave Murong's house sooner or later, but he didn't expect that it would come so quickly.
"Brother Wu Que, Xian'er, like you, has been fostered in Murong's family for ten years. In the past ten years, Xian'er has lived a very peaceful and happy life. Although Murong's family is small, it has peace and tranquility that cannot be found anywhere else. Here, I don't need to be afraid or sad in my life. And you, brother Wu Que, have you always by Xian'er's side, making Xian'er feel the warmth of family, and making Xian'er understand that there are things that Xian'er cherishes in this world. Xian'er will never forget all of this..."
It seemed that the string in her heart was deeply plucked, and Xianer's clear eyes were filled with tears, but she was not too sad, just deeply reluctant.
A pair of warm white hands gently embraced the girl into his arms. Lin Wuque stroked Xian'er's hair, with a look of reluctance, but the low words rang in Xian'er's ears: "Silly Xian'er, it's not a separation of life and death. Leaving Murong's house doesn't mean we can't meet again. You see, I am about to leave Murong's house to participate in the Hundred Cities War. Fortunately, you said goodbye to me first. If it were me, wouldn't I have to shed a few tears?"
"Pfft"
Xian'er, who was lying on Lin Wuque's shoulder, couldn't help but laugh out loud. She patted Lin Wuque gently with her little hand: "I hate it! Brother Wuque, you are making fun of me again..."
Xian'er's reluctance to leave was filled with Lin Wuque's words.Her smile seemed to be diluted a lot. She looked at Lin Wuque's handsome face with gentle eyes and asked softly: "Brother Wuque, you must come to Xian'er in the future, okay?"
Sensing Xian'er's expectations and anxiety, Lin Wuque couldn't help but feel sour. He had not been with his parents since he was a child, and he and Uncle Fu separated early. Although Murong Changqing regarded him as his own, it was Xian'er who gave Lin Wuque the most gentle and family-like feeling.
Now that the separation may be imminent, Lin Wuque's reluctance to let go is no less than that of Xian'er.
"Of course, no matter how far the journey is, Brother Wuque will definitely visit you in the future. This is Brother Wuque's promise."
Lin Wuque nodded heavily, with firm eyes and a firm tone.
Hearing Lin Wuque's affirmation, Xian'er burst into tears and smiled again, nodding her head as hard. The two looked at each other with a warm smile.
…
"With this separation, I wonder what it will be like when we meet again? Sora, is it true that people can't escape separation?"
The slightly melancholy words gently rang in his heart. Lin Wuque walked on the stone path after leaving Xian'er Small Building. The breeze brought a trace of parting reluctance and gently brushed Lin Wuque's cheek.
"Haha, there is always a banquet in the world. Even if we are close relatives of flesh and blood, we will have to part ways one day... Don't worry, this little girl is from the lineage of Phoenix Luan Goddess. With her state of melting the true spirit last night, she must have a high status among Fengluan Goddess. Although I don't know why Fengluan Goddess would let such a disciple be fostered in a small place like Murong's family, her future life will only get better and better."
"Feng Luan Tiannu? She seems to be very powerful. What kind of existence is she?"
Lin Wuque was not surprised that Kong could know about Feng Luan Tiannu. Kong had only lost the most important memory about who he was, but he could still recall some other memories that were not very important to him, such as identifying pills.
The goddess Feng Luan aroused a sense of curiosity in Lin Wuque's heart.
"In my remaining memory, there are some descriptions of this. This is why I can tell that the little girl is integrating the true spirit. Fengluan Heavenly Girl does not represent a person, but a collective name for a force with a long heritage. They are all women, but they are all powerful. Even in the place where all the forces gather, they have a very strong reputation!"
"Feng Luan Tian Nu's lineage has unique skills and extraordinary power, all of which are derived from the accompanying true spirits that are born in their bodies. Every year, Feng Luan Tian Nu sends countless disciples to explore the world, looking for infant girls with true spirits and bringing them into their sect. I think this little girl is the same. However, although Fengluan Tian Nu's line is powerful, she also has a weird temper and is not easy to get along with."
"Oh? It's quite a strange force.
Lin Wuque was secretly surprised by Kong's explanation, but he also understood that Xian'er would definitely not suffer after returning to Fengluan Tiannu, so he temporarily put aside his worries.
"In short, work hard. With your qualifications, if it hadn't been for the ten years of destruction of the Holy Law of Dou Zhan, your current achievements would not be as good as that of Jun Shan Lie. But if you drink and peck everything, you have spent ten years condensing the source of the holy law. In the future, you will get great blessings from it. Yes, the world is very big. As long as you keep getting stronger, one day you will find that the world is infinitely wonderful. "
Lin Wuque didn't understand that this was Kong Zai's disguised attempt to enlighten him. He smiled slightly, calmed down his mood, and with a flash of his body, he rushed towards the place where Murong Changqing lived.
"Uncle Changqing, I would like to see you in no uncertain terms. "
